newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Boost seen to crude output at Colombia's Apiay.
newsitem.headline: Boost seen to crude output at Colombia's Apiay.

text.p: New technology will permit state-run oil company Ecopetrol to boost output from its Apiay field in eastern Colombia by as much as 36 percent, the company said Monday.
Ecopetrol said in a statement that horizontal drilling would allow production to be increased from 47,000 barrels per day at present to about 63,000 barrels of crude per day.
The area in which Apiay is situated, the Apiay-Ariari block, has estimated reserves of 883 million barrels of crude, according to Ecopetrol.
